question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is '**of**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate preposition for the given blank is '**of**'.
 
• In the given context, it means 'belonging to, connected with, or part
